welcome.title: Welcome to Cyber CTF
welcome.description: Run realistic, isolated security labs on your machine, your own server or the cloud, launched from the app or straight from the website.
welcome.labsDescription: Docker containers and full virtual machines, each lab on its own isolated network.
welcome.whereDescription: On this machine, your own server (Proxmox, ESXi) or your cloud account (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and more), which stops itself when you're done.
welcome.targetsDescription: Exploit genuinely vulnerable systems from an attack box plugged into the lab network.
welcome.launchDescription: Start a lab from the website, even on your phone; it runs on the machine you pick.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.description: Connect your Cyber CTF account to register this machine and launch labs from any device.
signin.waiting: Waiting for the browser… (up to 5 minutes)
signin.hint: Opens <mono>cyberauth.co</mono> in your browser. Labs run without an account too: you can sign in later from Settings.

done.title: You’re all set
done.description: You can change any of this later in Settings or This machine.
done.notSignedIn: Not signed in (sign in later from Settings)
